audit_events_platform_summary_check.name: audit_events_platform_summary_check
audit_events_platform_summary_check.value: "audit_events"."scope" <> 'platform' OR NOT "audit_events"."tenant_visible" OR ("audit_events"."public_summary" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("audit_events"."public_summary")) > 0)

file_operation_batches_target_check.name: file_operation_batches_target_check
file_operation_batches_target_check.value: ("file_operation_batches"."action" = 'move' AND "file_operation_batches"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "file_operation_batches"."action" = 'restore' OR ("file_operation_batches"."action" IN ('trash','purge') AND "file_operation_batches"."parent_id" IS NULL)

file_entries_root_check.name: file_entries_root_check
file_entries_root_check.value: ("file_entries"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "file_entries"."kind" = 'folder' AND "file_entries"."name" = '' AND cardinality("file_entries"."path") = 0 AND "file_entries"."state" = 'active') OR ("file_entries"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND cardinality("file_entries"."path") > 0 AND "file_entries"."path"[cardinality("file_entries"."path")] = "file_entries"."name")

file_entries_name_check.name: file_entries_name_check
file_entries_name_check.value: "file_entries"."parent_id" IS NULL OR (octet_length("file_entries"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND CASE WHEN "file_entries"."kind" = 'folder' THEN 246 ELSE 255 END AND "file_entries"."name" = btrim("file_entries"."name") AND "file_entries"."name" = normalize("file_entries"."name", NFC) AND "file_entries"."name" NOT IN ('.', '..') AND position('/' in "file_entries"."name") = 0 AND position(chr(92) in "file_entries"."name") = 0 AND "file_entries"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]' AND "file_entries"."name" !~* '%(25)*(2f|5c)')

file_entries_trash_check.name: file_entries_trash_check
file_entries_trash_check.value: "file_entries"."state" <> 'trashed' OR ("file_entries"."trash_root_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_entries"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "file_entries"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

file_operation_objects_entry_check.name: file_operation_objects_entry_check
file_operation_objects_entry_check.value: "file_operation_objects"."entry_id" IS NOT NULL OR ("file_operation_objects"."directory" AND "file_operation_objects"."version_id" IS NULL)

file_operation_objects_bytes_check.name: file_operation_objects_bytes_check
file_operation_objects_bytes_check.value: ("file_operation_objects"."expected_bytes" IS NULL OR "file_operation_objects"."expected_bytes" >= 0) AND ("file_operation_objects"."actual_bytes" IS NULL OR "file_operation_objects"."actual_bytes" >= 0) AND "file_operation_objects"."transient_bytes" >= 0

file_operations_actor_check.name: file_operations_actor_check
file_operations_actor_check.value: ("file_operations"."actor_type" = 'user' AND "file_operations"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_operations"."maintenance_kind" IS NULL) OR ("file_operations"."actor_type" = 'system' AND "file_operations"."actor_id" IS NULL AND "file_operations"."maintenance_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "file_operations"."maintenance_kind" IN ('history_purge', 'trash_purge') AND "file_operations"."action" = 'purge')

file_references_kind_locale_check.name: file_references_kind_locale_check
file_references_kind_locale_check.value: ("file_references"."kind" = 'project_attachment' AND "file_references"."locale" IS NULL) OR ("file_references"."kind" = 'project_rich_text' AND "file_references"."locale" IN ('zh-CN', 'en-US', 'ar'))

file_storage_usage_values_check.name: file_storage_usage_values_check
file_storage_usage_values_check.value: "file_storage_usage"."quota_bytes" >= 0 AND "file_storage_usage"."used_bytes" >= 0 AND "file_storage_usage"."reserved_bytes" >= 0 AND "file_storage_usage"."transient_bytes" >= 0 AND "file_storage_usage"."trash_days" >= 1 AND "file_storage_usage"."history_days" >= 1 AND "file_storage_usage"."policy_revision" >= 1

personal_media_operations_size_check.name: personal_media_operations_size_check
personal_media_operations_size_check.value: "personal_media_operations"."declared_bytes" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND ("personal_media_operations"."actual_bytes" IS NULL OR "personal_media_operations"."actual_bytes" = "personal_media_operations"."declared_bytes")

personal_media_operations_commit_check.name: personal_media_operations_commit_check
personal_media_operations_commit_check.value: ("personal_media_operations"."phase" = 'completed' AND "personal_media_operations"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "personal_media_operations"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("personal_media_operations"."phase" <> 'completed' AND "personal_media_operations"."committed_at" IS NULL AND "personal_media_operations"."completed_at" IS NULL)

platform_schedule_runs_result_check.name: platform_schedule_runs_result_check
platform_schedule_runs_result_check.value: ("platform_schedule_runs"."status"='running' AND "platform_schedule_runs"."finished_at" IS NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."result" IS NULL) OR ("platform_schedule_runs"."status"='succeeded' AND "platform_schedule_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."error_code" IS NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."result" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("platform_schedule_runs"."result")='object') OR ("platform_schedule_runs"."status" IN ('failed','rejected') AND "platform_schedule_runs"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_schedule_runs"."result" IS NULL)

platform_schedules_next_check.name: platform_schedules_next_check
platform_schedules_next_check.value: ("platform_schedules"."status"='enabled' AND "platform_schedules"."next_run_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("platform_schedules"."status"='disabled' AND "platform_schedules"."next_run_at" IS NULL)

platform_menu_target_check.name: platform_menu_target_check
platform_menu_target_check.value: ("platform_menu"."kind" = 'directory' AND "platform_menu"."route_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."action_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."url" IS NULL) OR ("platform_menu"."kind" = 'page' AND "platform_menu"."route_key" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_menu"."action_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."url" IS NULL) OR ("platform_menu"."kind" = 'action' AND "platform_menu"."route_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."action_key" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_menu"."url" IS NULL) OR ("platform_menu"."kind" IN ('external', 'iframe') AND "platform_menu"."route_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."action_key" IS NULL AND "platform_menu"."url" IS NOT NULL)

platform_task_rows_result_check.name: platform_task_rows_result_check
platform_task_rows_result_check.value: jsonb_typeof("platform_task_rows"."result") = 'object' AND "platform_task_rows"."result" ? 'outcome' AND jsonb_typeof("platform_task_rows"."result"->'outcome') = 'string' AND "platform_task_rows"."result"->>'outcome' = "platform_task_rows"."status" AND (("platform_task_rows"."status" = 'failed' AND "platform_task_rows"."result" ? 'code' AND jsonb_typeof("platform_task_rows"."result"->'code') = 'string' AND "platform_task_rows"."result"->>'code' ~ '^[A-Z_]{1,100}$' AND "platform_task_rows"."result" - 'outcome' - 'code' = '{}'::jsonb) OR ("platform_task_rows"."status" <> 'failed' AND "platform_task_rows"."result" - 'outcome' = '{}'::jsonb))

platform_tasks_credential_check.name: platform_tasks_credential_check
platform_tasks_credential_check.value: ("platform_tasks"."kind" = 'export' AND "platform_tasks"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL) OR ("platform_tasks"."kind" = 'employee-import' AND "platform_tasks"."resource" = 'employees' AND (("platform_tasks"."status" IN ('pending','queued','running') AND "platform_tasks"."credential_ciphertext" IS NOT NULL AND length("platform_tasks"."credential_ciphertext") > 0) OR ("platform_tasks"."status" IN ('completed','failed','rejected') AND "platform_tasks"."credential_ciphertext" IS NULL)))

platform_tasks_result_check.name: platform_tasks_result_check
platform_tasks_result_check.value: ("platform_tasks"."status" = 'completed' AND "platform_tasks"."result_resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_tasks"."error_code" IS NULL) OR ("platform_tasks"."status" IN ('failed','rejected') AND "platform_tasks"."result_resource_id" IS NULL AND "platform_tasks"."result" IS NULL AND "platform_tasks"."error_code" IS NOT NULL AND "platform_tasks"."error_code" ~ '^[A-Z_]{1,100}$') OR ("platform_tasks"."status" IN ('pending','queued','running') AND "platform_tasks"."result_resource_id" IS NULL AND "platform_tasks"."result" IS NULL AND "platform_tasks"."error_code" IS NULL)
